**Finding: IP — Compliant (preferred level). No redline proposed.**

The document satisfies every preferred element:

| Element | Where |
|---|---|
| Customer owns Deliverables / work product | § 14.2 |
| Vendor assigns Deliverables | § 14.2 ("Vendor hereby assigns... all worldwide right, title, and interest") |
| Vendor retains pre-existing IP | § 14.3 + § 1.9 definition of Vendor Technology |
| Perpetual / irrevocable / royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP | § 13.2, applied to Deliverables by § 14.3 |
| Customer retains all rights in Customer Data | § 14.1 (+ § 1.3 broad Customer Data definition) |
| Vendor's data licence limited to providing the Services | § 14.1 ("solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer") — service delivery, not independent exploitation; reinforced by § 15.1's bans on sale, advertising, data combination and model training |
| No joint ownership | § 14.4 (none created absent a separate signed instrument fixing exploitation rights) |

Noted in the rationale only, not flagged: ownership of Deliverables is conditioned on payment of Fees, and § 15.1 includes an "as permitted by this Agreement" processing basis (a cross-reference, not an independent licence). Neither is a material failure of the fallback or preferred position.
